profile.headline: Principal IT Business Systems Analyst / Application Manager
profile.jobTitle: Principal IT Business Systems Analyst / Application Manager
profile.summary:
I am a seasoned Principal IT Business Systems Analyst and full‑stack engineer with deep experience building, integrating, and modernizing enterprise applications across manufacturing, data, and financial systems. Over the past 20+ years, I’ve delivered large‑scale solutions spanning Java, .NET, data engineering, AWS cloud, and analytics platforms used by global operations and executive leadership teams.
My career combines hands‑on development with technical leadership—designing system architectures, mentoring teams, optimizing performance, and driving business‑critical improvements in efficiency, data visibility, and operational insight.
In recent years, I’ve expanded into data engineering, building automated pipelines with Python and AWS, integrating SAP and MES systems, and delivering Tableau dashboards that empower management with real‑time, data‑driven decision making.
My passion is solving complex business challenges through clean architecture, high‑quality code, scalable cloud solutions, and a continuous improvement mindset.
Core Strengths:
✔ Full‑stack engineering (Java/J2EE, Spring, JSF/PrimeFaces, .NET)
✔ Cloud & data engineering (AWS, Python, PySpark, ETL pipelines)
✔ SAP & MES data integration
✔ System architecture & performance optimization
✔ Application management (WebLogic, Apache, IIS)
✔ Enterprise analytics (Alteryx, Tableau)
✔ Mentoring, leadership & cross‑functional collaboration

• BS, Computer Science, California State University Long Beach, 1996-1998 
• Sun Certified Enterprise Architect J2EE platform 2006 
• Sun Certified Business Component Developer (EJB) J2EE platform 2004 
• Sun Certified Web Component Developer (JSP and Servlet) J2EE platform 2003 
• Sun Certified Java 2 Developer (SCJD) 2001 
• Sun Certified Java 2 programmer (SCJP) 2001

positions.title: Principal IT Business Systems Analyst / Application Manager
positions.description:
Summary:
Lead developer and application manager responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise internet and intranet applications. Oversee application architecture, performance tuning, and web/application server management across Java, .NET, and AWS platforms.
Key Responsibilities:

Manage and support enterprise web applications, ensuring high performance, scalability, and reliability.
Lead development initiatives and mentor junior developers across multiple technology stacks.
Administer and optimize Oracle WebLogic, Apache, IIS, Git/SVN, and Mule ESB environments.
Design and integrate RESTful services, implement UI frameworks, and perform full‑stack development.

Recent Focus Areas (Most Recent Years):

Data Engineer — Data Warehouse Modernization

Build data pipelines to move data from multiple systems into AWS S3 using Python, AWS SDKs, and automation toolkits.


SAP Data Integration & Analytics

Extract SAP data, transform using Alteryx, and deliver executive Tableau dashboards.


MES (Manufacturing Execution System) Analytics

Integrate and prepare MES data with Alteryx and publish KPI dashboards for management.



Technical Environment:
AWS, Python, PySpark, Pandas, Java, J2EE, EJB3, JPA 2, Hibernate, iBatis, Spring Framework, JSF/PrimeFaces/Seam, RESTful Web Services, Spring MVC, JSP, Ajax (Prototype.js, jQuery), HTML/CSS/JavaScript, JSTL, Struts, Ehcache, Jersey, Axis2 SOAP, JMS, XML, Ant, Maven, Git/SVN, C#, ASP.NET MVC, Entity Framework, LINQ, MSSQL, Oracle, WebLogic Server, Agile methodology.

positions.title: J2EE Teachnical Lead
positions.description:
Responsibilities:

Served as technical lead for consumer-facing web applications.
Mentored junior developers and led application performance optimization.
Designed and developed modules using Java/J2EE, Spring Framework, and MVC architecture.
Supported build/release automation using Maven 2, SVN, and CruiseControl.

Environment:
Java, J2EE, Spring Framework, Spring MVC, Hibernate, MSSQL, WebLogic, Axis Web Services, Ajax (Prototype.js, jQuery), JMS, JSP, JSTL, XML, Maven 2, SVN, CruiseControl, Vignette CMS.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Aliso Viejo, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Responsibilities:

Designed and implemented both front-end and back-end components for web applications supporting J2EE deployment and version control.
Developed UI using JSF, JSP, and Servlets.
Built backend components using Spring, Hibernate, and design patterns.
Participated in Agile development and heavily utilized Test-Driven Development (TDD).

Environment:
Java, JSF, JSP, Servlet, Spring Framework, Hibernate, XML, JUnit, TestNG, Ant, XDoclet, JBoss, Tomcat, WebLogic.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:

Designed and implemented full-stack features for Loan Servicing and Loan Secure Exchange applications.
Built application modules using Spring, Hibernate, Struts MVC, and J2EE components (EJB, JSP, Servlet, JMS, MDB).
Utilized design patterns, JSTL, Tiles, XML, Web Services, and automated builds using Ant/XDoclet.

Environment:
Java, J2EE, EJB, Spring Framework, Hibernate, Struts, JSP, JMS, XML, Web Services, JUnit, Ant, XDoclet, MSSQL, Oracle, WebLogic.

positions.title: Sr. Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Responsibilities:

Designed interfaces to integrate multiple systems for the Loan Origination System.
Developed components using Java, J2EE, XML, XSLT, XPath, Unix/NT scripting, Perl, and Oracle.
Built a 3‑tier application enabling loan consultants to search and retrieve credit report data.
Employed J2EE design patterns, Struts MVC, Spring, and XDoclet on Sun ONE server.

Environment:
Java, J2EE (EJB, JSP, Servlet), XML, XSLT, XPath, Shell/Perl scripts, AppWorx scheduler, SQL, Oracle, Struts MVC, Spring Framework, XDoclet, Sun ONE Server.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:

Developed front-end and back-end components for web applications enabling online dental insurance claim submission.
Built UI using JSP, Servlets, EJB, HTML, XML, and XSLT.
Developed backend integration for transmitting claims to insurance companies using Java, SOAP, and SQL on WebLogic.

Environment:
Java, J2EE (JSP, Servlets, EJB), XML, XSLT, SOAP, MSSQL, Oracle, SQL, WebLogic.
